/**
   * Get the messages matching this live view from the database. Messages will
   * be sorted and grouped based on `sortColumn`, `sortDescending` and
   * `grouping`. Returns a promise resolving to an array of plain JS objects
   * containing the message properties.
   */
  [implicit_jscontext]
  Promise selectMessages();

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The first adapter used LiveViewRowMap, a lazy .at accessor and buffered synchronous selections. The accepted adapter has retired that class and awaits countMessages/selectMessages, with rows delivered through onSelectedChunk. Retain the original caching design as project history; do not apply its offset-based select contract to the current Promise API. Current tree data can be incomplete until its invalidation arrives. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep the first LiveView sparse adapter as historical architecture
